subject.title: fix(agents): apply_patch destroys an existing file when a patch creates that path

question: Should OpenClaw make Add File and non-self Move to create-only operations, even where existing agent workflows currently use them to replace an existing destination?
rationale: The proposed behavior is a compatibility-changing tool contract, while the mechanical implementation must also be redesigned to make the no-overwrite guarantee atomic.

options.title: Adopt create-only semantics
options.body: Keep the safety direction, but require an atomic backend-level create-if-absent operation and focused compatibility/race coverage before merge.

options.title: Preserve replacement semantics
options.body: Do not merge this behavioral change; instead define a different explicit overwrite or recovery contract if data-loss prevention remains desired.

recommendation.title: Adopt create-only semantics
recommendation.body: Keep the safety direction, but require an atomic backend-level create-if-absent operation and focused compatibility/race coverage before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Likely historical owner of the central agent file-editing surface and the best available routing candidate for the behavioral contract.
